snippet.title: Appulse - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A gameplay trailer for Appulse. Appulse is the fusion between pinball, top down shooter and roguelite where you need to protect your mothership from invading robots. Each shot affects your ball's trajectory, allowing you to control it in the heat of the battle. Upgrade your equipment and conquer new spaceships to win the war!
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
